label: Segmentation & analysis
note: Tools that measure a frame rather than make one: segmentation, tagging, optical flow, keypoints and structure-from-motion.

entities.name: YOLOv8 + Segment Anything
entities.summary: The pre-July detection and segmentation pair. YOLOv8 survives in one place as the hand detector.

issues.text: Box detection cannot answer a phrase question ('fishing net', 'both hands individually'), which is what prop persistence needs.

entities.name: SAM 3
entities.where: models/sam3 (sha-pinned), sam3_worker.py in the vlm_judge venv, sam3_service.py
entities.summary: Phrase-level segmentation, which made the prop-persistence gate possible: it can be asked whether the net is still in the shot.

issues.text: Validated on real frames: 'fishing net' 0.93, both hands individually 0.89, 4.3 s end to end; gate QGT-039 scored pipe 7/8 @0.81, ledger 8/8 @0.93, candle 8/8 @0.90 with a clean negative control.
The gate is built and advisory and the remaining step was never done — scene-plan prop phrases are not plumbed into the call, so it mostly runs on hand-written phrases.

entities.name: WD Tagger v3
entities.summary: Adopted because it is the only anime-native tagger: photo-prior taggers collapse roughly 5x on animated frames.

issues.text: Photo-prior taggers collapse ~5x on animation, which made every earlier measurement of animated material unreliable.

entities.name: RAFT optical flow
entities.summary: Replaced by GMFlow in the same animation-tooling review that brought in WD Tagger.

issues.text: Loses to GMFlow on this material.

entities.name: GMFlow
entities.summary: The flow estimator for motion analysis on animated and rendered material.

entities.name: BiRefNet
entities.summary: Fetched on first RGB input by the image→mesh pipeline; the matte is what makes a photo usable as mesh input.

issues.text: Loaded with trust_remote_code, which is a supply-chain surface the rest of the stack avoids.

entities.name: BlazePose / MediaPipe keypoints
entities.summary: The keypoint source behind geom.keypoints.detect. Its output is not interchangeable with the pose format the control graphs use.

issues.text: geom.keypoints.detect returns BlazePose-33, NOT OpenPose — a caller that assumes OpenPose indices reads the wrong joints.

entities.name: GLOMAP / pycolmap
entities.summary: Confirmed to be inside pycolmap 4.1.1 as global_mapping, so the SfM path needed no new install at all.

issues.text: A planned install turned out to be unnecessary — the capability was already in a dependency.

entities.name: MM-GDINO
entities.summary: Queued and never installed: it needs its own mmcv venv.

issues.text: Blocked on needing a separate mmcv environment; no measurement exists.

entities.name: CLIP
entities.summary: A pre-July survivor as an embedding model. Its one attempt at a promotion — judging defects — was measured and refused.

issues.text: Refused as a defect judge: it reports content, not faults.
